evidence.title: Parkinson's patients may protect memory and movement with one simple habit

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's activity classification
occurrences.quote_span: Vigorous activity included pursuits like jogging, fast bicycling, team sports and singles tennis, along with shoveling and carrying heavy loads.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's discussion and recommendations for randomized trials
occurrences.quote_span: Randomized studies are needed to confirm whether exercise directly slows cognitive or motor decline, according to the researchers.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's data-collection protocol
occurrences.quote_span: The participants reported their weekly physical activity via questionnaires.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's funding disclosure
occurrences.quote_span: The study was supported by a grant from the Gardner Family Foundation and the Precision Medicine in Neurodegenerative Diseases Fund.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's participant sites and demographic composition
occurrences.quote_span: The participants were all located at a single location and were primarily White, which could limit the generalizability of the results, the researchers noted.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's self-reported activity data and limitations
occurrences.quote_span: Also, as participants reported their own physical activity, they may not have accurately remembered how much they exercised.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's prespecified physical-activity group definitions
occurrences.quote_span: Participants were divided into three groups based on their amount of weekly physical activity — up to four hours, four to eight hours and more than eight hours.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study release's activity classification
occurrences.quote_span: Examples of moderate activity included brisk walking, light swimming, doubles tennis and household activities such as washing windows, vacuuming or mowing the lawn, the study release stated.
occurrences.speaker: study release
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's baseline cognitive assessments and published discussion
occurrences.quote_span: The researchers cautioned that most participants had relatively strong thinking and memory skills when the study began, so additional research is needed to confirm the findings.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's participant records and published methods
occurrences.quote_span: The research, led by the University of Cincinnati, included 294 patients with mild-to-moderate Parkinson's disease.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's comparison of physical-activity groups
occurrences.quote_span: Patients who were physically active for four to eight hours per week experienced slower declines in memory and thinking abilities than those who exercised less than four hours.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's statistical analysis and adjusted model
occurrences.quote_span: Each additional hour of physical activity per week was linked to slightly slower declines in memory, thinking and movement abilities over time, even after accounting for factors such as age, sex, education, weight and disease severity.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's participant demographics table
occurrences.quote_span: Their average age was 66.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's dose-response analysis
occurrences.quote_span: Exercise duration above eight hours per week did not appear to provide additional benefits for memory and thinking.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The published study's results and cited prior research
occurrences.quote_span: "Previous research has shown associations between physical activity and movement symptoms. Our study found physical activity may have dual benefits, with associations with slower declines in movement and cognition."
occurrences.speaker: Dong-Woo Ryu
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: Dr. Sharma's statement and clinical evidence on exercise and Parkinson's disease
occurrences.quote_span: "Exercise has well-established benefits for physical fitness and mobility, along with potential benefits for brain health through mechanisms that are not yet fully understood," Dr. Vibhash Sharma, a neurologist at UT Southwestern in Dallas, Texas, who specializes in Parkinson’s disease and other movement disorders, told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Vibhash Sharma
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's discussion and recommendations for randomized trials
occurrences.quote_span: Randomized studies are needed to confirm whether exercise directly slows cognitive or motor decline, according to the researchers.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study press release and medical references on Parkinson's disease progression
occurrences.quote_span: "Parkinson’s disease is a brain disorder that causes movement and cognitive problems that gradually worsen, leading to disability and a loss of independence," study author Dong-Woo Ryu, M.D., Ph.D., of the University of Cincinnati and The Catholic University of Korea, said in the press release.
occurrences.speaker: Dong-Woo Ryu
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study author's comments and study adherence analyses
occurrences.quote_span: Ryu pointed out that the potential benefits of physical activity for Parkinson’s patients may depend on how long they stay active and whether they continue exercising over time.
occurrences.speaker: Dong-Woo Ryu
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: Dr. Sharma's statement and the study's potential confounding analysis
occurrences.quote_span: "It is also possible that patients with inherently slower-progressing disease are more likely to remain physically active," Sharma added.
occurrences.speaker: Vibhash Sharma
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The published study on physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression
occurrences.quote_span: Weekly physical activity could help to slow down disease progression in Parkinson’s patients, a new study found.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's follow-up schedule and motor and cognitive assessments
occurrences.quote_span: One of the strengths of the study is that patients were followed over several years, with assessments of both motor and cognitive function, noted Sharma, who was not involved in the research.
occurrences.speaker: Vibhash Sharma
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: Neurology publication records for October 7, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: The study was published Oct. 7 in Neurology, the official medical journal of the American Academy of Neurology.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's follow-up records and protocol
occurrences.quote_span: The researchers then monitored the participants’ cognitive health for up to five years and their motor function for up to seven years.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: Dr. Sharma's statement and clinical guidance on Parkinson's disease management
occurrences.quote_span: "These findings further emphasize the importance of regular physical activity in managing Parkinson’s disease."
occurrences.speaker: Vibhash Sharma
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study design and causal-inference limitations
occurrences.quote_span: Because the study was observational, it could not establish whether exercise directly slows Parkinson's disease progression.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study author's statement and longitudinal study results
occurrences.quote_span: "While our study found small differences between activity levels, these differences may become more meaningful over time."
occurrences.speaker: Dong-Woo Ryu
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The study's activity-assessment protocol
occurrences.quote_span: Physical activity was assessed through structured interviews covering moderate and vigorous activities at work, at home and during recreation.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression

occurrences.checkable_against: The new study on exercise and Parkinson’s disease progression
occurrences.quote_span: A new study suggests exercise could help people with the neurodegenerative disease maintain both movement and thinking skills.
occurrences.speaker: new study
occurrences.subject: Physical activity and Parkinson's disease progression
